messages:
Kim: Heads-up — PR #3428 (migration-guide) is failing the docs preview. Linkcheck + a couple of Vale rules. Can reviewers pick this up before EOD? @Jordana @Ryan
Jordana: On it. Which Vale rule is tripping? any broken links listed in the bot output?
docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken link found -> docs/api/migration.md: reference to /api/v0/ref returned 404.
docs-ci-bot: vale: V101 cliche-detected in docs/migration/intro.md: 'cutting-edge' (level: warning).
Ryan: I can fix the link quickly — nav got renamed in the last site update. Will replace '/api/v0/ref' -> '/api/ref' and push. Also can tidy the heading style flagged by markdown-lint at docs/migration/intro.md:14.
Kim: Perfect. While you're at it, can you add a tiny SDK snippet showing the new client init? reviewers love examples.
Oliver: Note — repo requires two approvers for docs -> code-owner rule. I can approve once CI is green and one other approves. Also, merge window today is 11:30-12:30 PST if you want to avoid rollback conflicts.
Jordana: I'll do a content pass after the fix. If Ryan adds the snippet, I can suggest wording tweaks.
Ryan: Pushed patch: commit abc1234 — changed link, fixed heading, added SDK snippet. snippet:
```python
from redwood_inference import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(project="migration-examples")
resp = client.generate("migrate this example")
print(resp.text)
```
docs-ci-bot: Build triggered for PR #3428. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-3428--docs.redwood.ai
Kim: Reminder: if preview flakes, use the /rebuild comment on the PR or trigger via the docs CI dashboard.
docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: passed. vale: still one warning in docs/migration/intro.md (V101) — suggest alternate phrasing.
Jordana: I'll push a tiny wording change to remove 'cutting-edge' -> 'modern' and clarify intent. Will push to the same branch.
Ryan: ack.
Jordana: Pushed commit def5678 — replaced cliche, tightened snippet comment.
docs-ci-bot: All checks passed. Preview updated: https://deploy-preview-3428--docs.redwood.ai (status: success)
Oliver: LGTM, approving now.
Kim: Thanks — merging into main during the 11:30 slot.
Ryan: Merged. commit merged sha: 0f1e2d3.
Oliver: Quick follow-up: will create a tiny follow-up issue tracking the nav alias so we don't have another broken link during larger nav changes.
Kim: Good call. Filed issue #642: "Pin api/ref alias or add redirect for v0 -> /api/ref".
Jordana: Nice — also added a short note to the PR checklist to run `vale --config .vale.ini` locally before pushing.
Ryan: Will do. Thanks everyone :tada:
Kim: Closing thread. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
